name: Eggxecute the Perfect Romance
source:
A game where you're the victim!!

Eggxecute the Perfect Romance takes place in an early 2000s world where you-- yes, you--play as an undercover detective investigating a mafia front. You're forced to confront these hard earned criminals as an earnest rookie cop. On a good day you could call it a dark comedy...

[Edited from [url=https://swipage.itch.io/eggxecute]itch.io[/url]]
